description: Create a new Chirpie API key. Returns the full key once: keys are prefixed `chirpie_sk_` and the API never shows one again. Named scopes give a key that can do less than the calling key: a key created without any can do everything the key that made it can, and a key can never grant a scope it does not itself hold.

scopes.description: What the new key may do. Leave it out for a key that can do exactly what the calling key can do. Reading and listing API keys needs keys:write, because the key list is the inventory of the account's credentials.

name: chirpie_create_key
title: Create an API key
